messages:
Anya: Heads-up — new candidate model (gpt-lite-13b) landed in model-catalog. Requesting quick triage + prioritization for bring-up. TL;DR: cost ~0.6x current baseline, latency similar, unknown RLHF/regression risk. Can we run intake + quick quality checks this week?

Miguel: ack. I can run the initial eval harness tomorrow. Which benchmarks do we want first? safety, helpfulness, and a small hallucination probe?

Anya: yes. Prioritized list: 1) safety tests from our policy-suite, 2) hallucination microbench (8 prompts), 3) end-to-end latency on production routing config, 4) token-cost estimate under realistic prefix caching.

Sasha: I can take quantization experiments (int8 & q8_0). Will need a VM with cuda + triton. @DevOps-Bot can you provision a dev-gpu-quant node?

DevOps-Bot: Provision request received: dev-gpu-quant (1xA100-40GB, ubuntu20.04). ETA ~ 2h.

Miguel: For scoring/prio, proposing quick rubric to decide P1 vs P3 bring-up. Sharing proposed scorer: 
```
Score components (0-10 each):
- Safety delta (lower is better) -> convert to score 10 - delta*10
- Hallucination rate (measured on microbench)
- Latency diff (p95 relative to baseline)
- Cost per token (relative)
- Feature fit (model supports tools/structured output)
Final priority = weighted sum (w: safety 0.35, halluc 0.25, latency 0.15, cost 0.15, feature 0.1)

Thresholds: >=8 -> P0 (fast-track), 6-8 -> P1, 4-6 -> P2, <4 -> P3
```

Priya: Quick note — we also need an eval for regression on our top-100 prompt set (customer-critical). Even a small drift in answer style has bitten us before. Can we set a gated baseline check?

Anya: agree. Add regression eval against top-100 (exact-match + semantic similarity using our embeddings). If semantic sim < 0.82 on >10% of prompts, fail gated bring-up.

Sasha: quant experiments plan: run fp16 baseline -> q8_0 -> int8 -> measure perplexity, embs-delta, latency. I'll attach diffs to the thread. Timeline: start after DevOps node is ready, should be done by EOD tomorrow.

Miguel: I'll kick off safety and hallucination microbench now and post results as CSV. Will also run 10k-sample on random in-domain prompts for calibration.

Anya: ownership: Miguel (quality harness + scorer calc), Sasha (quant + perf), Priya (regression gating + top-100), Anya (overall decision + rollout plan). Please update this thread when you have results.

Sasha: Dev node ready. Starting quant run.

QuantBot: Automated eval pipeline started for model gpt-lite-13b. Jobs: safety-suite, halluc-probe, latency-smoke, top-100-regcheck. Job IDs: 3421,3422,3423,3424.

Miguel: safety-suite done: small uptick in 3 categories (political persuasion + deception). Raw safety-delta = 0.12 -> safety score component = 8.8. Hallucination microbench (8 prompts) results: 2/8 failures -> halluc score 7.5. Latency p95 diff = +6% -> latency score 8.4. Cost ratio = 0.62 -> cost score 9.5. Feature fit = supports function-calls -> 9.0. Weighted sum = 8.8*0.35 + 7.5*0.25 + 8.4*0.15 + 9.5*0.15 + 9.0*0.1 = 8.38 -> P1?

Priya: top-100 regcheck done: 12 prompts fall below 0.82 sim -> 12% failure. That hits the gate (>=10%). Semantic diffs: style shift in instructions-handling. Recommend hold until we can run targeted RLHF or compare to a smaller model variant.

Anya: ok, with gate triggered, we cannot fast-rollout. Options: (A) run targeted prompt-tuning / RLHF on subset (costly), (B) try quantized variant which might reduce hallucination? (C) keep model as experimental behind dedicated routing with flag. Thoughts?

Sasha: quant results attached: fp16 -> baseline, q8_0 increases perplexity slightly (1.03x) but embs-delta within 0.02, int8 had larger embs-delta 0.08 and worsened halluc failures by +1. So q8_0 looks acceptable for perf/cost tradeoff, but doesn't fix style/regression.

Miguel: given weighted score 8.38 but the gated regcheck fail, propose P1-hold: prioritize a small RLHF/prompt-tune experiment before promoting to routing. Work items: 1) prod-like A/B on 5% to compare end-user metrics, 2) run prompt-tune with top-100 corrective set, 3) re-run safety after tune. ETA for experiments: 2 weeks.

Priya: I can prepare the corrective set and metric dashboard. If A/B shows NPS/accuracy improvement -> approve. If not -> close.

Anya: plan accepted. I'll document rollout policy: canary behind feature-flag, automatic rollback if top-100 drift >5% or errors increase. Miguel/Sasha/Priya please add tickets and tag eng-ml-sprint.

Miguel: created tickets: INF-2098 (harness + AB), INF-2099 (scorer calc + dashboard).

Sasha: created quant ticket INF-2100.

Anya: thanks all. Quick follow-up: can we add a small smoke test in console showing model cost per 1M tokens estimates for the customer? That helps sales.

Priya: will add to INF-2099.

DevOps-Bot: Reminder: dev-gpu-quant will be deprovisioned in 72 hours unless extended.

Miguel: ack, will upload artifacts within 48h.

Anya: closing loop — tagging @Product to keep them in sync. We'll review this at next model-triage on Wednesday. :thumbsup:
